reason: Successfully tested agent functionality: navigated to app, found and clicked target agent, verified status, sent message, received response with correct answer, and captured screenshot.
steps: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — App loaded successfully showing home page with sidebar containing two agents.
Clicked on "QA-20261021-222610-7laz" agent in the sidebar — Agent page loaded showing agent details, status indicator, and message input field.
Verified agent status is "idle" — Confirmed agent status displays "idle" in the status indicator on the page.

Sent message "Hello! What is 2+2?" — Typed message into input field (ref=e225) and clicked send button (ref=e389). Message was successfully submitted and a new session "Basic Arithmetic Greeting" was created.
Waited up to 3 minutes for response — Used browser_run_code to wait for the activity indicator to disappear. Agent responded within approximately 1 minute.

Verified response mentions "4" and took screenshot — Agent responded with "2 + 2 = 4." which clearly contains the expected "4". Screenshot captured showing the complete conversation with both user message and agent response.
